A [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] '''duel''' took place between two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] at an unknown [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|Outer Rim spaceport]].

==Prelude==
The former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] resurfaced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> committing various acts of violence and sabotage throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] with the help of his [[Brother/Legends|brother]] and rogue [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="Revival" /> These acts included a [[Massacre on Raydonia/Legends|massacre]] of the innocent on the planet [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]]<ref name="revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> and an [[Battle of Moorjhone|attempted conquest]] of the planet [[Moorjhone]]; the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] actively pursed the brothers.<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref>

==The duel==
Maul and Opress eventually crossed paths with the Jedi in a [[Unidentified Outer Rim spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Opress [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] a [[Unidentified Nikto Jedi/Legends|Nikto Jedi]] while Maul confronted [[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. Savage, with his brute strength, beat down the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], knocking the wind out of him. Just as Opress was about to deliver the killing blow, Ertay jumped in the way and blocked the blow with her lightsaber; however, Maul used the momentary distraction to come up behind the preoccupied Jedi and [[Shiak|stab]] her with [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|his saber]]. The Nikto soon [[Death/Legends|followed]].<ref name="Revival" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel briefly appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] premiere [[Revival (episode)|episode]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] animated series, showing the death of Finn Ertay at the hands of Darth Maul. The trivia gallery on the [[StarWars.com|official website]] of the series confirms Ertay's identity, the setting of the duel, and the fate of the Nikto Jedi.
